categories.EXPERIMENT_BLOCKED: Any study-level administrative stop occurs; >20% common harness/environment/instrument defect occurs; authorization/identity/data integrity fails; or fewer than 75% of planned randomized pairs yield classifiable primary outcomes.
categories.BOTTLENECK_MIGRATION_INDETERMINATE: Not blocked, but HIGH manipulation checks fail; primary data/intervals cannot classify binding status; artifact/environment imbalance >=0.10 is sufficient to explain the observed yield difference; measurement overhead limits fail and sensitivity changes the migration call; or valid completed pairs provide <80% power for the frozen minimum effects.
categories.BOTTLENECK_MIGRATION_DOMAIN_DEPENDENT: Not blocked/indeterminate; full migration rule passes in at least one repository and task class and fails in at least one other, with a condition×repository or condition×task-class interaction Holm-adjusted p<0.05 or opposite 95% intervals; neither pattern spans the required 2 repositories and 2 task classes.
categories.BOTTLENECK_MIGRATION_SUPPORTED: Not blocked/indeterminate/domain-dependent; implementation is binding in LOW and ceases binding in HIGH, a named non-implementation stage newly binds in HIGH under bottleneck-definition.json, this occurs in >=2 repositories and >=2 task classes without significant opposite interaction, HIGH improves P1 or P2 by the frozen minimum (P1 >=15% or P2 >=0.10; Holm-adjusted 95% interval excludes 0), and H3/H4/H6/H7 artifact checks do not account for it.
categories.BOTTLENECK_MIGRATION_NOT_SUPPORTED: Not blocked/indeterminate/domain-dependent and the SUPPORTED rule fails with adequate power. Includes implementation remaining binding, no newly binding non-implementation stage, proportional acceleration, or precise null/opposite effects.

interpretation: Only one category is emitted using precedence. NOT_SUPPORTED is a valid negative/null outcome, not proof of universal absence. No category has been applied to empirical data.
